q: The Mandelbrot set is the set of parameters c ∈ ℂ for which:
opts: The orbit of 0 under fc(z)=z²+c is bounded
All orbits of fc are periodic
fc has a real fixed point
exp: The Mandelbrot set M = {c∈ℂ: fₙ_c(0) does not tend to ∞}. The critical point 0 is special: c∈M iff the orbit of the critical point is bounded, iff the Julia set J(fc) is connected.
